scenes.text: Does a ten-minute break really make a difference? The research says it can.
I always feel guilty taking a break.
Serein's Visual Atlas. Twelve illustrated guides for real working days.
Pressure is a shared responsibility. Each guide shows the evidence, who it's for, and when to use it.
Flip through. Breathe gently, without forcing. Come back to the room, with five senses.
Enlarge any page. A small break can make room: a meta-analysis of twenty-two studies, with over two thousand participants.
And if today is too heavy, real human support is one tap away.
So a break isn't selfish. It's part of the job.
A clearer picture, and a useful next step. Try it free today, at Serein dot Healthcare Crown Academy dot co dot uk.
